# Rahul Pahuja

> Principal Mobile Engineer specializing in mobile security architecture, and founder of Mobile1x. Creator of the Secured Storage layer at CyberArk. 10+ years building mobile infrastructure across CyberArk, Bankwest, and Conviva.

Rahul Pahuja is a mobile engineer based in Indore, India. He was most recently Staff Software Engineer at CyberArk (Nov 2024 – Dec 2025), where he designed and built the Secured Storage layer — the cryptographic foundation that protects enterprise credentials on Android and iOS. He now runs Mobile1x, an independent studio building privacy-first, on-device mobile apps (DeDup, Notes, AI Similarity). Over a decade he has built security-critical mobile infrastructure: credential vaults, observability SDKs operating at billions of events per minute, and digital banking platforms used by millions.

## Now

As of 2026, Rahul is building independently as founder and principal engineer of Mobile1x. Current products: DeDup (AI duplicate file cleaner, Android, Early Access on the Play Store) and Notes — The Modern Archivist (offline-first notes app, live on the Play Store and App Store). He also maintains AI Similarity, a developer reference that maps Android and iOS APIs side by side.

## Career

- **Mobile1x** — Founder & Principal Engineer (2025 – Present). Independent mobile product studio. Builds privacy-first, on-device apps end to end: product, architecture, and release. Products: DeDup, Notes, AI Similarity.
- **CyberArk** — Staff Software Engineer (Nov 2024 – Dec 2025). Designed and built CyberArk's Secured Storage layer, the cryptographic foundation protecting enterprise credentials on Android and iOS: TEE-backed key storage, hardware-bound encryption, biometric unlock, secure enclave integration. Drove mobile security standards adopted across the product org. Stack: Kotlin, Swift, MVVM/Clean Architecture, dependency injection with Hilt.
- **Coforge — Bankwest (Commonwealth Bank of Australia)** — Android & iOS Technical Lead (2024). Technical lead for Bankwest's digital banking app, used by millions of daily active users. Architected self-service features (password reset, currency conversion, account management); established code coverage standards and CI test pipelines.
- **Conviva** — Senior Engineer, Android Sensors (2022 – 2023). Built and maintained Android/iOS observability sensors processing 12B+ metric computations per minute; owned ExoPlayer and BrightCove integrations for audience quality measurement at streaming-platform scale.
- **Intellicus Technologies** — Senior Software Engineer (2019 – 2022). Developed the Intellicus Mobile SDK — embedded analytics and BI reporting for Android; integrated on-premise and cloud data sources for enterprise customers including Chevron and Shell.
- **Wipro** — Unified Mobile App Developer (2014 – 2019). Built an award-winning travel app on Wipro's Contextual & Open Banking Platform; set Material Design-first UI standards across Android.

## Training

Ran a Google-affiliated Android bootcamp in partnership with LTIMindtree — 41 engineers trained, 100% placed. Full curriculum from fundamentals through production-grade development.

## Skills

- Mobile: Android, iOS, Android SDK, iOS SDK, Kotlin, Java, Swift, Objective-C, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, UIKit, AVFoundation, ExoPlayer, BrightCove, Android Services, Content Providers, Broadcast Receivers, React Native, Flutter
- Architecture: MVVM, MVI, MVC, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (Hilt, Dagger, Koin), Architectural Decision Records (ADRs)
- Security: Secured Storage, TEE / Secure Enclave, Biometric Auth, hardware-bound encryption, Snyk
- Backend: Java, Python, Node.js, Spring Boot, Firebase, REST APIs
- Infra: Jenkins, TeamCity, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Docker

## Projects

- [Mobile1x](https://mobile1x.com) — independent mobile product studio; parent of DeDup, Notes, and AI Similarity.
- [DeDup](https://dedup.space) — AI-powered duplicate file cleaner for Android. Detects and removes duplicate photos, videos, APKs, memes, and WhatsApp clutter through on-device media analysis. Privacy-first: zero cloud uploads. In Early Access on the Play Store. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, MediaStore, Coroutines, MVVM, Clean Architecture.
- [Notes — The Modern Archivist](https://mobile1x.com/notes/) — offline-first notes app for Android and iOS. Voice memos, live speech-to-text, drawings, image OCR, reminders; everything stored locally on-device. Optional opt-in cloud AI (Gemini) for sorting notes and summarizing meetings; Google Sign-In sync. Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rp.notes — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/co/app/notes-archive-reflect/id6798175378
- [AI Similarity](https://www.aisimilarity.com) — developer reference that maps Android and iOS APIs side by side to speed cross-platform translation.
- [CodeForumBlogs](https://www.codeforumblogs.com) — community platform for technical writing with real-time collaboration and code highlighting.
